$comment: Data audit budgets (TEST-005), one entry per data tag, checked by scripts/data-audit.ts. Counts are exact for a pinned tag: a parser change that moves one updates this file in the same PR. Problem counts are ceilings and spellsWithDice is a floor. A DATA_TAG bump needs a new entry: run `bun run data:audit -- --tag <tag> --write-budget`, then review the diff. branchAllow entries are human verdicts that a multi-name additionalSpells block is a real choice even though the entity's own prose does not say so.

branchAllow.note: Circle Spells: the druid chooses the land where they became a druid. The wording lives in the subclassFeature, not the subclass entry.
Circle of the Land Spells: choose one land type, changeable after a Long Rest. The wording lives in the subclassFeature.
Divine Magic: choose one affinity for the source of your power. The wording lives in the subclassFeature.
Genie's Kind: the patron is one kind of genie. The wording lives in the subclassFeature.
